title: fix(cloud-connection): keep the binding credential under OS_HOME so a container recreate does not unbind the node
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Single-node defect S1 (open half), found by card 0 of #3814 (cloud#3868 comment 6723322368, V2). Maintainer ruling D2 (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「现在修，按普通 bug 卡」. This is a single-node bug fix, so it is NOT bound by #3814's R3.

## Problem (measured on the shipped EE image)
`cloud-connection.json` resolves to `<WORKDIR>/.objectstack/` in the container layer, not `OS_HOME=/data`. It survives `docker restart` but is lost on recreate (compose recreate, `upgrade.sh`'s image switch). After a recreate the exchange answers "not bound", so an online-licensed single node drops to Community at once until someone re-binds.

## Do
1. Resolve the binding credential file under `OS_HOME` (keep an explicit override variable if one exists).
2. Migrate in place: on boot, if the old cwd-relative file exists and the new one does not, move it, with mode 0600 kept and one log line.
3. Do not touch the multi-replica shared store (objectstack#31554 / PR #31584); coordinate with it if both edit the same resolver.
4. Tests: a fresh path under OS_HOME; an old file migrated once; both present = new wins, old left alone; mode 0600.

## Done when
PR merged; a container recreate keeps the binding on the same `/data` volume.

Cloud half (entitlement cache default path) is a sibling cloud card.
